def Target : Prop :=
  ∀ (Fm S : Type) [LogicalConnective Fm] [LogicalNeutral Fm] [Entailment S Fm] (𝓢 : S) [Entailment.Cl 𝓢]
    (T K D : Fm → Fm) (σ S₀ S' G P Q : Fm),
    Def6 𝓢 D T → Def5 𝓢 D K → Def7 𝓢 D T → Def8 𝓢 D K →
    𝓢 ⊢ D (σ 🡒 S') → 𝓢 ⊢ D (K (σ 🡒 G)) →
    𝓢 ⊢ σ 🡒 S₀ →
    𝓢 ⊢ S₀ 🡒 T σ 🡒 S' →
    𝓢 ⊢ S' 🡒 G →
    𝓢 ⊢ S' 🡒 ∼P →
    𝓢 ⊢ Q 🡒 P →
    𝓢 ⊢ σ 🡒 K (σ 🡒 G) 🡒 Q →
    𝓢 ⊢ ∼σ

All quantifiers over Fm, S, the connective/entailment structures, 𝓢, T, K, D, and σ, S₀, S', G, P, Q are universal at the outermost level, while the universal quantifiers over φ (and ψ) in hypotheses (1)–(4) appear inside those respective hypotheses. Nothing further is required: 𝓢 is not assumed to be consistent, Def1–Def4 are not assumed, and T, K, D are arbitrary functions from sentences to sentences with no additional logical, syntactic, or semantic constraints."}
